h: Peter Obi makes four demands over the arrest of supporter Rilwan Olawale
p: Peter Obi has called for the release of a supporter, Rilwan Olawale, who was reportedly arrested, and accused the Tinubu government of undermining democracy. He set out four demands over the arrest.
more: The arrest has drawn reactions from supporters and critics of the opposition online.
A separate report says a man arrested over an X post spent about ₦400,000 on the ordeal.
The authorities have not yet commented publicly on the specific demands.
